body.title: Can the AI tools that search the web read your site?

untrusted_site_text.prompt:
### Can the AI tools that search the web read your site?

- **Check:** [RCH-1](https://openstandard.readinessindex.io/standard/#rch-1) (failed gate)
- **Worth:** 6 points
- **Effort:** small

**What the scan found.** An example finding.

**What the scan recorded.** Nothing the scan could point at — this check is about something it could not see on the pages it read.

**How it is measured.**

> Parse `robots.txt`. Evaluate each of the nine search crawlers (`OAI-SearchBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Googlebot`, `bingbot`, `Applebot`, `MistralAI-Index`, `meta-webindexer`, `Amzn-SearchBot`) against the rule set, for `/` and for three sampled content URLs. Resolve `User-agent: *` fallbacks and the longest-match group rule, and let a crawler inherit the group it falls back to: Applebot follows the `Googlebot` group when `robots.txt` does not name it. Training crawlers and the fetchers that act on a person's request are evaluated as well and shown in PST-1; they never change this band.

**What to change.** An example finding.

**What full marks look like.**

> Every one of the nine may fetch content paths.
